Team — forwarding the signed SOW and Hannah's summary. High-level internal notes before the handoff call: 

- Customer: Aurora Edge (fintech/edge compute) — sensitive PII flows, will require SOC2 evidence and tighter retention controls.
- Deployment type: Redwood Private (VPC), want HSM-managed keys (customer-managed KMS).
- Traffic profile: expected 1.2M tokens/day at go-live, bursting to 2.8M during peak trading windows. We advised dedicated capacity with burst buffer.
- Success criteria: acceptance test pass for latency SLA <= 120ms p95 and production ingest at 75% of projected load.
- Risks: customer network team requires granular egress IP ranges (need final list by 12/28). Legal may request two minor SOW redlines (data retention clause and audit schedule).

Action items for CS: 
1) Assign primary Implementation Lead + SRE for cutover (Ben suggests Karthik as lead, Tessa as ops steward).
2) Schedule 60-min kickoff the week of Jan 4 (morning PST preferred).
3) Start security evidence packet prep (SOC2 artifacts + dataflow diagram).

I will attend kickoff for the first 30 min to introduce stakeholders. Karthik / Tessa — please confirm owners and any immediate blockers.

—Ben
